figures.caption: Fig. 7. Illustrations of captions generated by Qwen-VL-Max, the baseline model, and T2T. They cover types of mobile apps, including video, shopping, and music. In each caption, verbs are marked in deep red, interface components in blue-gray, and app types in green.
Fig. 2. Overview of T2T. It contains a flow feature encoder, a caption decoder, and a cross-modal annotation and training scheme.
